fusions.name: Torpor Dart
fusions.desc: Fires a chilling dart that deals 6 damage and leaves the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Basking Glare
fusions.desc: Throws open your visor and glares in a wide cone, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Spare Tail
fusions.desc: Drops a spare tail that fights for 12 seconds, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunned Hide
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 15%.
